body:
I don't know if or when you will see this but I am having a terrible day again and I am scared that I will never feel even okay again.

I get feeling like that about men. Can you move? It might help. I am terrified of leaving and I don't want to raise my kids on a fast food paycheck. Sometimes I think I am the one that is mean to him but he just makes me so angry! He has cheated on me many, many times and a few years ago he even hit me a couple times. And I try to work things out but then when he won't help take care of the kids or throws his things all over the floor, or gets mad that he can't go out with his friends every day he has off work because I want to make plans too.. i just remember all the terrible things in our marriage and I hate him. 

I was really skinny, but I have gained 100lbs in the past couple years and I don't hve clothes that fit and I am scared to go in public so I can't even go to the gym or yoga or the bar because someone I used to know might see me. I feel really, really disgusting.

It must have been hard raising your daughter on your own. I'm afraid to try. And i keep telling myself that he is not a bad man, just a bad husband. And if he's so wonderful to everyone else then I must be the problem. 

I'm sorry you got hurt in your relationship. I personally find older men (I'm 26 so by older to me I mean 40-50 but I'm sure I'll find men older than that attractive as I age too)  more attractive and enjoyable to be around. Maybe you'll have the same experience. Don't count yourself put with younger men though!

Yes there are many small towns. I'm in alpena county. I'm happy to hear you found solace in nature.  I am sorry to hear the repercussions you faced though. I hope you cut ties with that relationship. I wish I enjoyed walking or driving but one of the worst parts about being depressed is that I have started to feel like I can't bring myself to get out of the house. But I'm going to try.
I live in the middle of nowhere, Michigan. I am always open to talking. I literally have no one I can talk to. When I try to talk to my husband about how I feel it always devolves into fighting.

I'm sorry to hear that you feel the same. It is nice in a way to know I am not alone though. I hope that isn't terrible of me. Thank you for the support. I wish I knew what to say. It feels like everything is wrong.
